subject: prd/incident-machinery
statement: Where an agent captures or graduates an incident, a vendor-neutral `/incident` authoring skill shall drive the operation through the writer verbs — an agent never hand-allocates an ID or hand-writes an entry.
rationale: the prompt-side half of INV-35, matching the other authoring skills
fit_criterion: the skill exists on the vendor-neutral surface with vendor pointer shims; its instructions invoke the writer verbs and forbid hand edits
